sentence: This project uses artificial intelligence and genomic sequencing to shorten the diagnostic odyssey for children with rare lung diseases.
This project studies what happens when two proteins that help stop tumors are restored in head and neck cancer.
This project provides technology, data and analysis support for research on stress, trauma and resilience.
This project holds a conference where experts discuss how immune receptors work and how immunotherapy targets autoimmunity, infectious disease and cancer.
This project studies how T helper cells primed by healthy skin commensals defend against pathogens in acne.
This project develops gene therapy with CRISPR to treat Lowe syndrome, a rare disease that causes glaucoma and cataracts.
This project studies the components and processes that control the dopamine transporter in intact brain.
This project develops and uses genomic technologies to study the genetic and molecular basis of tumor biology.
This project provides advanced light microscopy methods for studying metabolic tissues.
This project studies the structure of the cellular machinery that makes concanamycin A and how it is stored inside cells.
This project tests whether estradiol changes an amygdala circuit that controls negative valence and leads to persistent negative bias after intense stress.
This project develops ways to find cohorts in electronic health records using information retrieval and deep representation techniques.
This project develops and tests a pilot program for genomic screening for common genetic conditions in primary care.
This project studies how networks linking the lateral prefrontal cortex and anterior cingulate cortex change with age and relate to cognitive decline in monkeys.
This project tests how a family of RNA-binding proteins controls stemness and differentiation of acute myeloid leukemia cells.
This project uses CRISPR screens to find out what asthma candidate genes do in human bronchial epithelial cells and T cells.
This project builds engineered macrophages that can track and control inflammation in vivo, using ultrasound, MRI and optical imaging.
This project tests whether genes or chemicals change the deficits caused by prenatal alcohol exposure in cell and animal models.
This project studies how resistance to drugs develops in Candida auris, a fungal pathogen.
This project studies how mutations in a brain transcription factor affect human oligodendrocyte development and maturation.
